title: A conditional recoverable compliance gate has exact switching paths and a sharp distinction between homogeneous stability and global spatial control
reported_status: Preserved producer claims and separate internally derived results. Source claims, internally derived proofs and same-team criticism remain unreviewed externally. scientific_scope_status: Earlier FI scope: Supplied scalar coexistence sextic and adjustable positive quartic gate plus conjugate field; local elastic elimination assumes zero preload and a realizable control port. A finite-lattice mixed local/shared quartic functional is a mathematical architecture. Actual compatible elastic kernels, finite-temperature selection/retention, finite-time losses, material constitutive parameters and work-recovery efficiency remain unacquired. Later selected-source update reports a compatible finite-pitch one-dimensional piezo model with a global all-amplitude selected-path inequality under explicit margins, plus synthetic fast-failure/slow-success cycles and one unoptimized direct-pulse comparison; see material_updates. The physical tuple, 3D interface, noise/retention and matched advantage remain unacquired. P2 source update reports a compatible finite-pitch one-dimensional model with a global all-amplitude H1 path inequality for a selected known-input -B to +B transfer under explicit positive margins. The source reports synthetic fast-cycle failure, slower-cycle success and one unoptimized direct-pulse comparison; an exact reset obstruction excludes nonuniform pattern writing under the same connected 1D bounded-amplitude contract. This is model-level source evidence only: the material tuple, three-dimensional interfaces, finite-temperature retention, independent proof review and matched practical advantage remain unacquired or UNKNOWN.
